dsh-odette-skin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A Genshin Impact "Odette" themed DSH UI skin: dark/light dual-mode background images, frosted-glass overrides for 13 theme tokens, and a chibi mascot sidebar toggle; install via npm
